description: Transaction log ops view: used%/MB pressure, reuse-wait root cause, FULL+LOG_BACKUP action queue, growth companion metrics, per-server rollup. Collector mssql_log_usage @ 60s.

targets.expr: mssql_log_used_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} and on(instance, db, log_reuse_wait_desc, recovery_model_desc) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} >= ${warn_pct})

mssql_log_total_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} and on(instance, db, log_reuse_wait_desc, recovery_model_desc) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} >= ${warn_pct})

(mssql_log_total_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} - mssql_log_used_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"}) and on(instance, db, log_reuse_wait_desc, recovery_model_desc) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} >= ${warn_pct})

panels.title: High Used % (>= Warn) - size + recovery + reuse wait
Reuse Blocked (wait != NOTHING) - why log cannot truncate
Inventory (topk 40 by Used %) - filtered by Server/DB/Wait
System DBs (master, model, tempdb, msdb, DWConfiguration, DWDiagnostics, DWQueue)

targets.expr: bottomk(15, (mssql_log_total_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} - mssql_log_used_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"}))

(count by (instance) ((mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} >= ${warn_pct}))) or (count by (instance) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"}) * 0)

(count by (instance) ((mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"} >= 85))) or (count by (instance) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"}) * 0)

(count by (instance) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc!~"NOTHING|"})) or (count by (instance) (mssql_log_used_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}", log_reuse_wait_desc=~"${reuse_wait:regex}"}) * 0)
